presentation.speaker: mara_quinn
presentation.title: Fuel price spike
lines: Pump prices jumped and airport travellers are renting fewer cars. Cut rates for two weeks to keep the fleet moving, or hold your prices and ride out weaker demand.

choices.label: Cut rates for two weeks
choices.outcome: Rates drop 8% for 14 days and demand recovers faster.

choices.label: Hold prices
choices.outcome: Rental demand falls and recovers slowly over three weeks.
